hook.name: BasedBidHook
hook.description: A configurable Uniswap v4 hook that collects per-pool fees on every swap (static, dynamic adaptive+surge, or tiered), distributing them among LPs, token buybacks, reward recipients, and custom wallets. Supports optional per-pool anti-sandwich protection, cooldown penalties for rapid repeat traders, and whitelist-period buy limits enforced via Merkle proof.
